```{r, echo = F}
# Install required packages

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)

library(blockCV)

```

#read in VRM and tidied useage data for the sites where we have measured VRM
```{r, echo =F}
vrm_select <- readRDS("vrm.rds")

vrm_select

```


# mixed effects model with sdmTmB of anchoring events

## scaling and centering predictor variables
```{r}

#scale predictors
preds <- dplyr::select(vrm_select, 
                       total_events,
                       total_events_premulti,
                       total_time,
                       total_time_premulti,
                       years_used,
                       last_used,
                       years_since_use,
                       depth,
                       swing, 
                       swing.modified)
preds_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(preds, center = T, scale = T))
names(preds_scaled) <- paste0(names(preds_scaled), "_scaled")
preds_scaled <- cbind(preds_scaled,
                      vrm_select)

preds_scaled

preds_scaled <- preds_scaled %>% mutate(rug_200 = ruggedness_200m/100)


  
```


#making a mesh for the sdmTMB model
```{r}
#add in lat and long to data
 
get_crs(preds_scaled, c("Longitude", "Latitude")) #function from sdmTMB to check coordinates crs


preds_scaled <- add_utm_columns(preds_scaled, c("Longitude", "Latitude")) # add in x and y columns in UTM


# need to make a mesh, required for sdmTMB because it is a spatial package, can turn off when running model though

mesh <- make_mesh(data = preds_scaled, xy_cols = c("X", "Y"), cutoff = 1) #the cutoff is km

plot(mesh)

preds_scaled <- preds_scaled %>% mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)# if you don't turn site into a factor sdmTMB will explode and not run

```

#fitting a sdmtmb model to the VRM 200 m using a beta regression, comparing 3 models using AIC (with spatial random field on or off and a with and without a random effect for basin)

```{r, echo = F}

# model with events


M1_rand_nospatial <-sdmTMB(formula = rug_200 ~ total_time_premulti_scaled + depth_scaled + use + Type + (1|main_anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "off", family = Beta(link = "logit"), data = preds_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

M2_rand_spatial <-sdmTMB(formula = rug_200 ~ total_time_premulti_scaled + depth_scaled + use + Type + (1|main_anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "on", family = Beta(link = "logit"), data = preds_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

M3_norand_spatial <-sdmTMB(formula = rug_200 ~ total_time_premulti_scaled + depth_scaled + use + Type, mesh = mesh, spatial = "on", family = Beta(link = "logit"), data = preds_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))


# correlation and VIF factor between variables VIF of 3
# spatial field acts as a latent variable to account for spatial effects that are not accounted for by fixed effects

AIC(M1_rand_nospatial,M2_rand_spatial, M3_norand_spatial)

#checking simulation based randomized quantile residuals using DHARMa https://github.com/florianhartig/DHARMa/issues/181
set.seed(123)
s <- simulate(M1_rand_nospatial, nsim = 500, type = "mle-mvn")
dharma_residuals(s, M1_rand_nospatial)

sanity(M1_rand_nospatial)
summary(M1_rand_nospatial)

preds_scaled$resid2 <- residuals(M1_rand_nospatial)
qqnorm(preds_scaled$resid2)

qqline(preds_scaled$resid2)

confint(M1_rand_nospatial)

# real space value of 1 SD time
sd(preds_scaled$total_time_premulti, na.rm = TRUE)


visreg::visreg(M1_rand_nospatial, "total_time_premulti_scaled", scale = "response")
visreg::visreg(M1_rand_nospatial, "total_time_premulti_scaled", scale = "response")

#The package ggeffects can be used to plot marginal effects of given predictor variables in sdmTMB models.

#A advantage to this approach over visreg, is that ggeffects calculates marginal effects with the effects package using the parameter covariance matrix. This is nearly instant compared to visreg, which has to calculate conditional effects by calculating predictions with TMB.

#A disadvantage to using ggeffects is that it will only work for regular linear effects in the main model formula. I.e., it will not work with smoothers (internally these are random effects) or breakpoint (breakpt()) effects.

#Another important distinction is that ggeffects::ggeffect() is plotting marginal effects. This means the effects are “marginalized” or “averaged” over the other fixed effects. visreg::visreg() is plotting conditional effects. This means they are conditional on the other predictors being set to certain values. ggeffects::ggpredict() also does conditional effects, but this has not yet been set up in sdmTMB using the CRAN version of ggeffects.


predict_final <- ggeffects::ggeffect(M1_rand_nospatial, "total_time_premulti_scaled") %>%  
  rename(total_time_premulti_scaled = x)


predict_final <-as_tibble(predict_final)

#un center and unscale the predictions
predict_final <-predict_final %>% mutate(total_time_premulti = total_time_premulti_scaled*sd(preds_scaled$total_time_premulti)+
             mean(preds_scaled$total_time_premulti))

```


# model coefficients and confidence intervals
```{r}
summary(M1_rand_nospatial)
confint(M1_rand_nospatial)

```

# plot of model response with raw data points coloured by use (Active/Inactive)
```{r, echo = F}

threshold_df <- predict_final %>%
  arrange(total_time_premulti) %>%
  mutate(
    slope = (predicted - lag(predicted)) /
            (total_time_premulti - lag(total_time_premulti))
  )

threshold_df %>%
  filter(slope == max(slope, na.rm = TRUE))

max_slope <- max(threshold_df$slope, na.rm = TRUE)

threshold_df %>%
  filter(slope < 0.5 * max_slope) %>%
  slice(1)

threshold_value <- threshold_df %>%
  filter(slope == max(slope, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(total_time_premulti)

lowthreshold_value <- threshold_df %>%
  filter(slope < 0.5 * max_slope) %>%
  slice(1) %>% pull(total_time_premulti)


p <- ggplot(preds_scaled, aes(x = total_time_premulti, y = rug_200)) +


  # model confidence ribbon
  geom_ribbon(data = predict_final,
              aes(x = total_time_premulti,
                  ymin = conf.low,
                  ymax = conf.high),
              fill = "#7B6FD6",
              alpha = 0.1,
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
   # raw data
  geom_point(aes(fill = use),
             colour = "grey50",
             alpha = 0.8,
             size = 1.8,
             shape = 21) +

  # model prediction line
  geom_line(data = predict_final,
            aes(x = total_time_premulti,
                y = predicted),
            colour = "#4B3FBF",
            linewidth = 1.2,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = threshold_value,
             linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "black") +
     geom_vline(xintercept = lowthreshold_value,
             linetype = "dotdash",
             colour = "black") +

  labs(
    x = "Summed Occupancy Time pre MBES Survey (hours)",
    y = "Vector Ruggedness Measure (200 m radius)",
    fill = "Site status"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "current" = "#D450A6",   # pink
      "used" = "#E69F00"       # orange
    ),
    labels = c(
      "current" = "Active (including reference sites)",
      "used" = "Disused"
    )
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

threshold_df

p
```
